name: Correlation — Remote Execution then LSASS Credential Dump (same host)
description:
Attacker objective
Land on a host via remote execution (WMI, WinRM, or a PsExec-style service) and then harvest credentials from LSASS to move deeper into the network.

Attack logic
A hands-on intrusion frequently pairs remote code execution on a target with immediate credential theft from that host's memory. Detecting the two steps in sequence on the same host is a high-confidence confirmed-intrusion signal.

Why this detection works
Correlating a remote-execution parent process with a subsequent LSASS-dump on the same host within a short window links lateral movement to credential access, each of which is already anomalous.

False positives
Extremely low — LSASS dumping is essentially never legitimate; the remote-execution precursor adds context.

Tuning
Exclude verified administration workflows only if they genuinely perform both steps (very rare).

Required telemetry
Sysmon Event ID 1 and Windows Security 4688 (process, parent, command line) correlated by host.name.
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. A remote-execution vector (WMI/WinRM/PsExec) was followed by an LSASS credential dump on the same host.
2. This is a confirmed lateral-movement-plus-credential-theft chain — isolate the host, rotate all credentials used on it, and begin IR.
3. Identify the source host that initiated the remote execution and contain it as well.
false_positives: Extremely low — LSASS dumping is essentially never legitimate; the remote-execution precursor adds context.
query:
sequence by host.name with maxspan=1h
  [process where (event.code == "1" or event.code == "4688") and process.parent.name in~ ("wmiprvse.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","winrshost.exe","psexesvc.exe")]
  [process where (event.code == "1" or event.code == "4688") and ((process.command_line like~ ("*lsass*") and process.command_line like~ ("*procdump*","*minidump*","*nanodump*","*dumpert*","*sqldumper*","*createdump*")) or (process.command_line like~ ("*comsvcs*") and process.command_line like~ ("*minidump*","*#24*")))]
